prerequisites: It is advisable to have passed the Industrial Automation course from the 2nd year.

learning_outcomes.text: Capacity for critical thinking and self-criticism
Applied knowledge of industrial informatics and communications
Ability to design industrial control and automation systems
Learn to use formal tools for modeling and simulation of complex production systems.
Acquire knowledge about device communications in industrial environments.
Acquire a solid conceptual basis on computer-integrated manufacturing, analyzing CAD/CAE/CAM systems.
Learn to program numerical control machines.
Understand the need for SCADA-type supervision systems and learn to use a tool for their development.
Understand the need to model a production system to improve its performance.

syllabus_topics: Topic 1. Production systems in Connected Industry 4.0: Modeling and Simulation
Practical 1. Design and construction of a prototype using subtractive manufacturing
Topic 5. Monitoring and Supervision: SCADA Systems
Topic 6. Artificial Vision in Connected Industry 4.0
Topic 7. Augmented Reality in Connected Industry 4.0
Practical 2. Development of an industrial supervision system
Block 4. Industrial Communications and the Internet of Things (IIoT)
Topic 8. Cyber-Physical Systems and the Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT)
Practical 3. Implementation of industrial communication networks
assessment_rules: The final grade is calculated as: 0.2 * Problems + 0.3 * Practices + 0.2 * Project + 0.2 * Written test + 0.1 * Participation. A minimum grade of 5 out of 10 is required for each individual activity (exercise sets, lab practices, course project, and written test). The participation grade is only added if all other main activities are passed. Late submissions for exercises, practices, and the project will have a maximum grade of 8.0, with a 0.5 point deduction per day of delay, down to a minimum of 5.0 points if approved. For the extraordinary call, specific re-submission or re-examination rules apply for each component, and participation may involve an interview.
